description.other: Send plain text or Markdown with the current Session’s bound Feishu Bot. Requires user authorization for the destination and content. Specify receive_id + receive_id_type, or reply_to_message_id. Returns message_id; never sends as a user.

receive_id.other: Recipient ID; required for a new message, omitted for a reply.

receive_id_type.other: Recipient ID type; required with receive_id.

reply_to_message_id.other: Message ID to reply to; mutually exclusive with recipient fields.

reply_in_thread.other: Reply within a topic; only valid with reply_to_message_id. Defaults to false.

text.other: Message body, preserved verbatim. Use format=markdown for rich text. Encoded content, including the rich-text envelope, must not exceed 20 KiB.

uuid.other: Optional deduplication key, at most 50 bytes. Reuse with identical destination, format and content on retries; Feishu deduplicates for one hour.

destination.other: Specify receive_id and receive_id_type, or reply_to_message_id; do not combine them.

id_type.other: receive_id_type must be chat_id, open_id, user_id, union_id, or email.

session.other: Feishu messaging requires the current bound Session and its agent credential.

unbound.other: The Session has no active Feishu Bot binding.

ambiguous.other: The Session is bound to multiple Feishu Bots; resolve the bindings before sending.

unavailable.other: The bound Feishu Bot is unavailable.

lookup.other: Cannot resolve the Session’s Feishu Bot: %s

empty_response.other: Feishu returned no message ID; delivery is uncertain. Retry only with the same uuid.

format.other: Body format: text (default) or markdown. Markdown uses Feishu rich text and its supported syntax; images are not downloaded or uploaded.

invalid_format.other: format must be text or markdown.
